article.title: Amnesty International calls for abolition of ICE for the first time in new report
article.author: Editor
article.content: International human rights organization Amnesty International has called for the abolition of U.S. Immigration and Customs Enforcement in a new report alleging human rights abuses in the Trump administration’s immigration operations. The post Amnesty International calls for abolition of ICE for the first time in new report appeared first on MR Online .
